headline: World Bank Report Alleges Corruption in Kenya Railway Project
summary: A World Bank report alleges that Kenya spent $900 million more than necessary on its Chinese-built railway due to corruption and fraudulent procurement practices. This debt burden continues to weigh on the national economy.
why: Infrastructure debt is a major concern for emerging market economies; allegations of corruption can impact future financing and sovereign credit ratings.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: Corruption allegations can increase borrowing costs and damage international investor sentiment.
